title: Clarity
description: At the start of your next turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
smart_description: At the start of your next {Amount:plural:turn|[blue]{}[/blue] turns}, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
notes: Counter-type power that accumulates across multiple turns. Each stack adds 1 to hand draw and decrements by 1 at the end of each turn. Distinct from DrawCardsNextTurnPower due to stacking behavior—Clarity allows multiple active applications to coexist and stack their draw bonus.
